hypothesis: Preserving the union of Dense Top20 and BM25 Top20 candidates can prevent premature loss compared with Hybrid_RRF Top20 candidate truncation.
baseline: existing Hybrid_RRF Top20, with Original_C0 Top20 as context
proposed: Dense Top20 union BM25 Top20, per-view provenance maintained
primary_endpoint: macro candidate-pool recall (positive-label queries), not F1/nDCG
secondary: 16 provisional transfer cases retained, pool size, per-query gains/losses
limitations: Candidate pool upper bound only. Precision mapping and final output unexecuted. This cannot establish final model improvement. RRF is comparator only.
success_condition: Do not claim algorithmic success until unchanged architecture precision mapping and F1 increase/nDCG non-worsening with independent verified labels and uncertainty
